gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-fs-supreme: Literary and a little old-fashioned, Noto Serif Khmer sets a dark, weighty band of lowercase with softly thinning bowls. Supreme takes over with crisp, open sans-serif letters, and a slightly smaller body size lets its heavy strip of text breathe.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and confident, its tall letters filling every line. Noto Serif Khmer, with stems barely heavier than its connecting arms, earns its keep big and short, where its bookish, traditional character can show.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-manrope: Bookish meets friendly. Noto Serif Khmer gives soft thick-thin shifts and a literary weight, and Manrope offers round, bright-mouthed sans letters whose rims match their stems, so one brings tradition and the other ease.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-montserrat: Old-world texture over modern geometry. Noto Serif Khmer carries gentle stroke variation in its heading, so a body in Montserrat, with its wire-smooth, generous curves, looks best at a modest size beneath it.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-satoshi: Noto Serif Khmer lays down a dark, literary band of lowercase. It excels at calm, unsnagged modulation in the heading, while Satoshi's soaring sans letters, all cut with one width, handle the quiet body work.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-switzer: Noto Serif Khmer has a light swell in each bowl, like pressed glass, and a traditional, literary tone that suits large display lines. Switzer's tubular sans-serif forms stay tall and wire-like beneath.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khmer-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and crisp, with its mean line set high and its c tips held apart. Under Noto Serif Khmer's thinning arches, it keeps a long stretch of text moving like lines drawn with a fixed pen.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khojki-archivo: Big open counters in every small letter give Noto Serif Khojki its refined, bookish face. And Archivo's commanding x-height would overpower it if the heading shrank too small, so keep the heading generous.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khojki-fs-asap: Noto Serif Khojki brings stems just a touch thicker than its connecting strokes, with curves that thin modestly where they turn. Asap handles the plain, readable work underneath.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khojki-fs-epilogue: Bookish curves meet bent wire here: Noto Serif Khojki carries gentle weight shifts in every bowl, with refinement in its headings. Epilogue's monoline sans skeleton does the easygoing, tall-bodied reading.
